Called Update local admin based on cell value changes.
True if the value change is allowed, False to block the value change.
This method differs from OnCellValueEdited; during a cell value change notification (at the end of an edit operation) it is unsafe to modify the value of the cell being edited. However, the end edit event will not be triggered for particular specialized cells which makes this method mandatory.

Update lock, should be set when modifying cell values from the code to prevent recursive update/notification loops.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Event that will be thrown when the state monitor is invalidated. In response, user interfaces may want to re-assess their content.
The monitor that sent the event. -----------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Checks whether a state is met.
True if the requested state has been met.
Checks cascade recursively, starting at the foundation state. A state can only be met if its preceeding states are met. Each state may involve a combination of MSE configuration checks, core data validations, and MSE - core compatibility checks.
For performance reasons the states are cached once determined. This will lead to bugs if the state monitor is not explicitly cleared by outside managing code when needed by calling .
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Forget the cached states in the monitor, requiring new state assessments.
In response, the monitor may broadcast an event.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
